label: Sales Call Preparation Brief
description: Prepares comprehensive pre-call briefing for prospect or customer meetings. Includes company research, contact intelligence, tailored talking points, likely objections, and suggested next steps.

claudeKnowledge.description: Company news, regulatory updates, industry context

guidedInputs.label: Company and contacts
guidedInputs.placeholder:
Company name, industry, size, location.
Contacts attending: name, title, role in decision.
Any background on the contacts (LinkedIn, previous interactions, known interests).

guidedInputs.label: What do you want to achieve in this meeting?
guidedInputs.placeholder: e.g., Understand their compliance programme gaps, confirm budget authority, agree next steps to proposal

guidedInputs.label: What we already know about them
guidedInputs.placeholder: Previous interaction history, known pain points, things they have said, documents shared, any research already done

guidedInputs.label: What we are selling / proposing
guidedInputs.placeholder: e.g., AMLR gap analysis and remediation programme, AML advisory retainer, SaaS compliance tool

guidedInputs.label: What are you worried about going into this meeting?
guidedInputs.placeholder: e.g., They seem price-sensitive, I don't know who the real decision maker is, our last call went off-track, they mentioned a competitor
